messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "heart failure can get worse while dose is being increased"
set: ["heart failure can get worse while dose is being increased", "can lead to kidney failure", "untreated heart failure risks in pregnancy", "inform doctor about heart disease or congestive heart failure", "heart disease is common", "can make brain function worse in people with cirrhosis", "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on worse chest pain", "risk is high when the dose is changed", "heart disease is not always known about", "too much thyroid hormone can cause other heart problems", "heartburn can mimic early symptoms of a heart attack", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using gabapentin", "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on a heart attack", "new or worse depression or anxiety", "do not breastfeed while taking", "problems may occur when your dose is changed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
